title: Authorization hardened roles and review orchestration
creator: Maya Chen
description: Scope: Implement a hardened RBAC and orchestration layer designed for auditor-ready evidence and region-aware scoping. This ticket covers: 1) role taxonomy cleanup (reduce overly-permissive 'admin' shadow roles), 2) finer-grained role scoping tied to data residency tags (so access to EU-resident data requires EU-scoped roles), 3) SCIM provisioning drift detector that surfaces mismatches between Identity Provider state and Redwood's account roles, 4) SAML AuthNContext mapping and enforcement for step-up authentication on high-risk actions, and 5) automated periodic access review runbooks and evidence export to PDF/CSV for compliance teams. Deliverables include architecture docs, the SCIM drift detector service, RBAC migration script, SAML mapping enforcement, and a scheduled access-review job that produces auditor-ready reports and a verifiable changelog.
acceptance_criteria: Role taxonomy doc published and reviewed by security and product
Roles can be constrained by data_residency tag and enforced at API routing layer
SCIM drift detector runs hourly and surfaces a remediation queue in Console
SAML AuthNContext enforcement triggers step-up MFA for protected actions and is tested end-to-end
Periodic access review job generates signed PDF/CSV evidence and writes entries to immutable audit log
Migration plan has rollback steps and a staging dry-run completed
tasks: Design role taxonomy and residency scoping model
Implement RBAC checks in auth middleware with residency-aware evaluation
Build SCIM drift detector and remediation API
Add SAML AuthNContext mapping logic and step-up hooks
Create scheduled access-review runner and evidence export pipeline
Write migration scripts and a staged rollout plan
Add observability: metrics, alerts, runbook for failed enforcement
progress_updates: 2025-03-06: Kickoff with Security, PM and Console teams. Agreed to preserve existing role IDs and add residency tags instead of renaming in-place.
2025-03-08: Prototype RBAC middleware changes implemented in the feature branch; unit tests added for residency tag checks.
2025-03-10: SCIM drift detector PoC running against a snapshot of a customer IdP. Found 12 mismatched accounts - working on remediation flow UI.
2025-03-12: SAML team validated AuthNContext mapping approach; step-up flow demoed with Okta test org. No major perf regression observed in staging.
comments: PM (R. Patel): Need exported evidence to include policy version and reviewer signatures for auditors.
Security (L. Nguyen): Ensure that evidence exports are stored in an immutable store and retention meets 7 years by default for enterprise customers.
Eng (R. Ortega): Will add a feature flag to gate residency enforcement during rollout. Rollback plan documented in links.
decisions: Prefer tagging existing roles with data_residency rather than creating parallel role sets (minimizes disruption to integrations).
SCIM detector will compare group membership and custom role attributes, reporting a severity score for drift.
Evidence exports will be cryptographically signed and include a reproducible queries manifest for later verification.
review_feedback: Design: Add a fallback policy for legacy tokens that predate role tagging (G. Alvarez).
Security: Require MFA step-up for export of evidence artifacts containing PII (L. Nguyen).
Product: Default access-review cadence set to quarterly for enterprise customers; weekly for high-business-impact projects (S. Park).
notes_for_engineers: Use existing audit-log writer to append signed evidence entries; do not modify log retention settings in this ticket.
Feature flag: feature.access_residency_enforcement (default: off for orgs with legacy integrations)
SCIM detector should be idempotent and safe to run concurrently; persist last-checked timestamps per org.
